items.question: What makes a good TikTok dance video?
items.answer: The best TikTok dance videos combine an unexpected subject with a trending dance. The surprise factor drives rewatches, which signals TikTok's algorithm to push your content to more viewers.

items.question: Which dance templates work best for TikTok?
items.answer: Our trending templates are updated regularly based on what's currently viral. The Silhouette Groove, Lil Yachty Walk, and Aura Farming templates consistently perform well on TikTok.

items.question: Can I use these videos commercially on TikTok?
items.answer: Yes. Videos you generate are yours to use however you want, including for TikTok creator programs, brand content, and monetized accounts.

items.question: What video format works best for TikTok?
items.answer: All our templates generate vertical 9:16 videos optimized for TikTok's full-screen format. Videos are HD quality and ready to upload without any editing.

items.question: How often are new TikTok dance templates added?
items.answer: We monitor TikTok trends and add new templates as dances go viral. Popular templates are typically added within days of a trend emerging.

items.question: Will TikTok flag AI-generated dance videos?
items.answer: Our videos are generated using motion-control AI that produces natural-looking movement. Many creators successfully post AI dance content on TikTok as entertainment content.
